seasons.title: Vikaspedia (Govt. of India), medicinal plants: Agro-techniques of selected medicinal plants (NMPB)
seasons.quote: the seeds are sown during the second week of July to August

days_to_first_harvest.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, medicinal crops
days_to_first_harvest.quote: The crop is ready for harvest in 150-170 days after sowing, starting from January upto march.

harvest_span_days.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, medicinal crops
harvest_span_days.quote: The crop is ready for harvest in 150-170 days after sowing, starting from January upto march.

spacing_row_cm.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, medicinal crops
spacing_row_cm.quote: The seedlings of six weeks old are transplanted at a spacing of 60X 60 cm.

spacing_plant_cm.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, medicinal crops
spacing_plant_cm.quote: The seedlings of six weeks old are transplanted at a spacing of 60X 60 cm.
spacing_plant_cm.note: Vikaspedia gives 20-25 x 10-15 cm for dense stands; TNAU's 60 x 60 is used for a transplanted crop.

water_need.title: Vikaspedia (Govt. of India), medicinal plants: Agro-techniques of selected medicinal plants (NMPB)
water_need.quote: There is no need of irrigation if rainfall is at regular intervals.
water_need.note: A crop grown on rainfall with life-saving irrigation is read as 'low'. Agronomist to confirm.

waterlogging_tolerant.title: Vikaspedia (Govt. of India), medicinal plants: Agro-techniques of selected medicinal plants (NMPB)
waterlogging_tolerant.quote: Excessive rainfall/water is harmful to the crop.

height_max_cm.title: Vikaspedia (Govt. of India), medicinal plants: Agro-techniques of selected medicinal plants (NMPB)
height_max_cm.quote: grows up to a height of 1.5 meter

expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, medicinal crops
expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.quote: The crop produces 400-1200 kg/ha dried roots and 200-500 kg seeds/ha.
expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.note: 400 kg/ha = 0.04 kg/m² of dried roots (lowest figure).

economics.title: Vikaspedia (Govt. of India), medicinal plants: Agro-techniques of selected medicinal plants (NMPB)
economics.quote: In Madhya Pradesh, where it is grown on commercial scale, no fertilizer is applied and the crop is cultivated on only residual fertilizer.
economics.note: Madhya Pradesh grows it commercially on residual fertility (low input cost); TNAU lists 'Jawahar 20' as the Madhya Pradesh variety.

source_notes: AI research batch 15 (2026-10-08), medicinal and ayurvedic crops. Ranges are stored at their lower bound; the source range is in each quote. Yields are of the dried product that is sold (dried root, leaf or seed) unless a note says fresh. Sowing dates are from national guides (region india) unless a Malwa study is named. Medicinal crops are planned only when the owner picks the medicinal method; the market for each is thin and buy-back is not assured (see the economics sources).

price_mandi_paise_per_kg.note: Dried root, average of the last 6 months across the herbal markets NMPB tracks (national, not Neemuch alone). Rs 295.45/kg.
